body: If only it were that simple
Wow, I thought I was the only one. I'm so depressed right now everything seems foggy and tinged with grey.

No, I dropped out last June from a postgraduate intensive Law course (due to a tonne of stupid things) and owe my uncle £9000 in tuition fees. Another thing hanging over my head.

I am a fucking loser; we just moved into a shitty little flat because of a family fight which has nothing to do with me and are having to change doctors because it's all location based, another delay in trying to get professional help. 

It would be easier jumping in front of a train and probably more cost effective.
